guide.title: How do we compare prices?
guide.prices: We show monthly subscriptions, included credits or usage time, and verified top-up prices. Annual plans show both the monthly equivalent and the upfront yearly charge.
guide.units: Subscription unit prices are a reference for understanding costs. Credits work differently across tools and do not represent a fixed number of videos or images.
guide.updates: Prices are not collected in real time. After 30 days, a review reminder appears alongside the last verified price. Featured order is editorial, not a quality ranking.
